title: A tongue samples the air
hook: Following a trail can involve chemistry.

knows: Animals have structures and behaviors that can be investigated.
doesNotKnow: The dots in the drawing represent chemical particles picked up by the tongue and brought back to a sensing region in the mouth. A tongue flick samples chemicals; the dots and path are simplified, not literal measured trajectories.

misconception: The evidence in the scenario supports a different interpretation.
objective: A snake flicks its tongue, then returns it to the mouth. What can the tongue carry back for chemical sensing?
